result.description: Zoho Cliq is a team chat and collaboration platform with channels, bots, and a developer platform.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 via Zoho API console client registration (Client ID/secret). Scopes use the format service_name.scope_name.operation_type, e.g. ZohoCliq.Messages.CREATE. Access tokens last 1 hour; refresh tokens are supported. Data-center-specific accounts.zoho.{dc} endpoints.
result.access_detail: Register a client at the Zoho API console and get a Client ID and secret. The REST docs state no plan restriction, and Cliq has a free plan. I did not check the pricing page, so free-plan API limits are unconfirmed. Multi-data-center handling is needed, with 9 DC domains.
result.api_notes: REST API v3 at https://cliq.zoho.com/api/v3, with v2 still available. Covers chats, messages, threads, scheduled messages, channels, reminders, pins, stars, attachments, bots, slash commands, message actions, widgets, datastores, schedulers, extensions, and user settings. Postman collection available.
